hypothesis.statement: On real cardiorespiratory signals (BIDMC-01 RESP + PLETH), the newly-authored mutualInformation (histogram estimator, 16 equal-width bins, nats) reproduces sklearn.metrics.mutual_info_score on the identical binning BIT-FOR-BIT; and the mutual information of the real pair (~0.077 nats) exceeds a shuffled-surrogate control (~0.024, the histogram estimator's finite-sample bias) -- a genuine undirected dependence (the respiratory modulation shared by the two signals).

analysis_plan.dataset: BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset (PhysioNet), subject 01, RESP + PLETH decimated to 25 Hz, 200 s (5001 samples each)

decision.threshold: descriptive: the mutual information equals sklearn.metrics.mutual_info_score to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9), AND the real MI exceeds the shuffled-control MI
